verdict.rationale: telli documents workflows that send SMS and WhatsApp messages to recipients drawn from contact properties or collected values. The changelog says a Scheduled trigger lets a workflow run "without a call event", which implies workflows are normally triggered by call events. Event-triggered rule definition is only inferred from that wording. The Scheduled trigger is a recurring schedule, not an event trigger, and webhooks are outbound notifications rather than in-product rules, so neither earns credit here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of event-based trigger types, conditional rule logic and the range of available actions, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
